note.ja: 固定400/800/1600ステップの古典RK4で物理状態を積分します。独立参照はlog x・log yの変数でRadau/BDFを実行し、主計算には対数変数や保存量の射影を導入しません。
note.en: Integrate physical populations with classical RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independent Radau/BDF references evolve log x and log y; the primary method uses neither a log-coordinate update nor invariant projection.

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 限定した実行例：1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test. Scoped executed example: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.

note.en: Measure state error against the independent reference, drift of H and the minimum saved population separately. The reference stage qualifies analytic Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement, tolerance refinement and the identity dH/dt=0.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 無次元の捕食者・被食者系x′=x(1−y)、y′=y(x−1)、初期値(1.2,0.8)、0≤t≤20。正の象限で不変量H=x−log x+y−log yを評価します。 1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the dimensionless predator–prey equations x′=x(1−y), y′=y(x−1), initial state (1.2,0.8) and 0≤t≤20. Evaluate H=x−log x+y−log y only in the positive quadrant. This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.
